t: A biology lesson where students check an app that names plants from photos.
steps: Find the Plants Around Us lesson plan in the Czech AI curriculum.
Read the plan and the presentation.
Check that the Pl@ntNet app or site works on student devices.
Print the worksheets and gather pens and scissors.
Choose a plant or plants for students to photograph.
Test the app with one photo before class.
Run the lesson and have students compare the answers to online images.
